label: Говорить
description: Scaffold verb card for second-conjugation typing practice. Expand each person into five sentences for the full 30-line deck.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular. 1. 'Говорю' is the standard present form. 2. 'По-русски' is a high-value adverbial phrase. 3. This is a core identity sentence for the learner.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular. 1. 'Говоришь' shows the -ишь ending. 2. 'Тихо' adds a very common adverb. 3. The sentence is short and useful for speech practice.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular. 1. 'Говорит' is the core second-conjugation form. 2. 'Правду' gives the line semantic weight. 3. This is a practical, common sentence.
Strategic focus: First-person plural. 1. 'Говорим' reinforces the plural pattern. 2. 'О книге' adds a prepositional complement. 3. This is useful for discussion language.
Strategic focus: Polite/plural form. 1. 'Говорите' trains the respectful form. 2. 'Медленно' keeps the sentence simple and flexible. 3. This is useful in live conversations.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural. 1. 'Говорят' closes the person ladder for the family. 2. 'Громко' makes the sentence vivid. 3. It is a clean ending point for the scaffold.
